description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Large taker orders (default >= $100k) on Hyperliquid perps (top 40 markets) in the last window with side, USD size, price, taker address, plus net whale buy/sell per coin. Built for polling. Returns JSON large Hyperliquid taker orders plus net whale buy and sell per coin.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Optional Hyperliquid coin. Format: a coin symbol. Example: SOL. Omit for the top 40 markets.

limit.description: Maximum orders. Format: positive integer. Example: 50. Omit for the server's current cap.

min_usd.description: Minimum taker-order notional in USD. Format: a number. Example: 100000. Default: 100000, which is the $100k floor the tool text states.

side.description: Optional taker side. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: buy. Omit for both sides. Allowed values: buy, sell.

window.description: Look-back window. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: 1h. Allowed values: 15m, 1h, 4h, 24h, 7d.

name: whale_moves
title: Whale moves ($0.005)
